title: Crystal Burst Brake
description: A Fabric client performance guard that temporarily reduces particle intensity during dense nearby crystal bursts and restores the original setting afterward.
body:
# Crystal Burst Brake

Crystal Burst Brake is a Fabric client performance guard for crystal PvP. When nearby end crystals start stacking up, it temporarily lowers particle intensity and restores your original particle setting after the burst passes.

The goal is not to remove combat information. The goal is to smooth out the exact frame spikes that happen during dense crystal trades, especially on servers where crystal fights can flood the client with visual effects.

## Features

- Scans nearby end crystals in a configurable radius
- Temporarily switches particles to Decreased or Minimal during dense bursts
- Restores your original particle setting automatically
- HUD status showing nearby crystal pressure and restore timing
- Mod Menu config for radius, trigger count, brake mode, cooldown, and HUD layout

## PvP Fairness

Crystal Burst Brake does not place crystals, break crystals, target players, click, rotate, or automate inventory. It only changes a vanilla client video option during heavy local particle pressure.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Loader: Fabric
- Requires: Fabric API
- Optional: Mod Menu for in-game configuration
